paragraphs: I am Yujie Zhang (张宇杰). I am a postdoctoral fellow at the [Institute for Quantum Computing](https://uwaterloo.ca/institute-for-quantum-computing/) at the University of Waterloo and am also associated with the [Perimeter Institute for Theoretical Physics](https://perimeterinstitute.ca/). I received my PhD in Physics from the University of Illinois at Urbana–Champaign and my BSc in Physics from Kuang Yaming Honors School at Nanjing University.

My research lies at the intersection of quantum foundations, quantum information, and quantum optics. I investigate different notions of nonclassicality—including generalized noncontextuality, measurement incompatibility, entanglement, quantum steering, and nonlocality—with a focus on their relationships, certification, and quantification. I also use these insights into nonclassical resources to develop practical protocols for quantum metrology and communication in quantum networks. Publications and preprints are available through [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/a/zhang_y_54.html) and [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=nbA1QlUAAAAJ&hl=en).
